title: 88Vape Any Tank Mixed Berries 10ml E-Liquid- 6mg
description: 88Vape’s Mixed Berries from the Anytank series is a medley of mouthwatering berry flavours, perfectly balanced with a refreshing minty finish. This e-liquid captures the essence of ripe blackberries and sweet blueberries, complemented by the ruby tang of fresh raspberry. Each inhale brings a burst of berry goodness, while the mint adds a fresh, cooling effect to the exhale, making it a unique and invigorating vaping experience. The combination of these flavours results in an e-liquid that is both tantalisingly sweet and refreshingly cool. This 50/50 e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at wallet-friendly prices.
